attempt_contract.id_policy: Task Session allocates one new immutable UTC attempt ID at selected-unit admission.
attempt_contract.collision_policy: Reject an existing attempt root, unresolved attempt token, target drift, or material-package mismatch.
attempt_contract.success_teardown: Retain terminal evidence, close transient processes, and route owner closeout.
attempt_contract.failure_teardown: Retain block evidence, close transient processes, and keep the same canonical cursor.
